title: 第3章 捡漏第4章 活着真好
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 半个时辰后，秦关来到了一片高山下。
在他的前方，群山连绵，看不到尽头，漆黑静谧的山林隐隐的地透着一股原始与危险的气息。
万妖谷，又称死人谷，里面宝贝奇遇众多，同时吃人的妖兽遍布山林，一不小心就会丧命于此。
望着眼前这片深邃无尽头的大山，秦关钻了进去。
刚进山林，秦关就看到了好几批人在小心翼翼的前行。
秦关孤身一人，也很快吸引了很多人的注意。
“少年，一个人进山勇气可嘉，不过这里可不是逞强好胜的地方，要不要加入我们，多一个人多一份照应？”
一名长相粗犷的中年男子冲着秦关喊道。
秦关刚要说什么，一名长相清冷的女子突然道：“人不在多在于精，你让他进来拖后腿吗？”
听到那女子的话秦关淡淡一笑，加快了脚步朝着深处走去。
一连翻过几座山头，秦关毛都没发现，一路上只看到了几只小狐狸，小灰狼。
妖兽的皮毛血肉以及内丹都价值不菲，这些年来，万妖谷外围经常有佣兵或者各个家族势力组织狩猎妖兽。
一来可以获得资源财富，二来可以有效的历练，增强实战能力，所以一些妖兽都迁移到了深处远离人类。
半个时辰后，秦关来到一处开阔的山地，他翻过了好几座大山，一根虎毛都没发现。
就在秦关有些苦恼时，东南方向突然传来一道浑厚的虎啸声。
听到老虎叫声，秦关心下一喜，急忙朝着东南方向掠去。
翻过一座山头，秦关很快来到了刚才虎妖咆哮的区域。
就在秦关目光搜寻时，前方一处山林中，一头浑身是伤的虎妖怒吼咆哮。
远远望去，那头虎妖身形魁梧，足足有一丈多高，看上去虎躯凛凛，浑身上下散发着一股强大的妖气。
而在它的前方正躺着三名名身受重伤的年轻人，三人捂着胸口死死的看向虎妖，眼神中涌出一股绝望之色，他们低估了虎妖的实力，今天怕是要命丧于此了！
吼！
虎妖仰头怒吼，似是在宣誓自己不容侵犯的王者之气，下一刻它猛的朝前一跃，锋利如铁钩的尖爪直接抓向一名残血的少女。
少女脸色煞白，就在她绝望之际，一名手持木棍的少年突然来到虎妖头顶上方。
砰！
少年猛的一棍直接敲在了虎妖的脑门上。
虎妖惨叫一声，它的四肢抽搐了几下后轰然倒地。
被秦关一棍子敲死了…
看到这一幕，三名年轻人直接惊呆了。
看了三人一眼，秦关抓起地上惨死的虎妖转身离开，很快消失在山林中。
约莫一个时辰，秦关终于回到了天宝阁，此时天色已经黑了下去。
来到灵材售卖区，秦关找到了先前答应他的老板。
当秦关把一头硕大的虎妖掏出来后，灵材店的老板眼睛直接瞪成了牛蛋，难以置信道：“小子，你来真的？”
“不换吗？”秦关皱眉道。
“换，当然换！”老板急忙点头。
content_en:
Half an hour later, Qinguan arrived at the foot of a high mountain.
In front of him, there were mountains with no end in sight. The dark and quiet mountains and forests faintly exuded an aura of primitiveness and danger.
The Valley of Ten Thousand Monsters, also known as the Valley of the Dead, has many treasures and adventures. At the same time, man-eating monsters are all over the mountains and forests. If you are not careful, you will die here.
Looking at the deep and endless mountains in front of him, Qin Guan got in.
As soon as he entered the forest, Qin Guan saw several groups of people moving forward cautiously.
Qin Guan was alone and quickly attracted the attention of many people.
"Young man, it's commendable to be brave to go into the mountains alone, but this is not a place to be aggressive. Do you want to join us? One more person and one more person to take care of you?"
A middle-aged man with a rough appearance shouted at Qin Guan.
Just when Qin Guan was about to say something, a cold-looking woman suddenly said: "It's not just the quality that makes people more beautiful, are you letting him come in to hold you back?"
After hearing the woman's words, Qin Guan smiled faintly, quickened his pace and walked towards the depths.
Climbing several mountains in a row, Qin Guanmao didn't notice it. He only saw a few little foxes and little gray wolves along the way.
The fur, flesh, flesh, and inner elixir of monsters are all valuable. Over the years, mercenaries or various family groups have often organized to hunt monsters outside the Ten Thousand Demons Valley.
Firstly, they can gain resources and wealth, and secondly, they can gain effective training and enhance their actual combat abilities, so some monsters have moved to the depths to stay away from humans.
Half an hour later, Qinguan came to an open mountainous area. He climbed over several mountains without finding a single tiger hair.
"Roar!"
Just when Qin Guan was feeling a little distressed, a loud roar of a tiger suddenly came from the southeast.
Hearing the tiger's cry, Qin Guanglan was overjoyed and hurriedly flew toward the southeast.
After climbing over a mountain, Qinguan quickly came to the area where the tiger demon roared just now.
"Roar!"
Just as Qin Guan was searching, in a mountain forest ahead, a tiger monster covered in wounds roared angrily.
Looking from a distance, the tiger demon was burly, more than a foot tall. It looked like a tiger with a majestic body and exuded a powerful demonic aura.
In front of it lay three seriously injured young men. The three of them clutched their chests and looked at the tiger demon with a look of despair in their eyes. They underestimated the strength of the tiger demon, and they were probably going to die from this today!
roar!
The tiger demon raised its head and roared, as if to declare its inviolable kingly aura. The next moment, it jumped forward fiercely, and its sharp claws as sharp as iron hooks directly grabbed a young girl with residual blood.
The girl's face turned pale, and just when she was desperate, a young man holding a wooden stick suddenly appeared above the tiger demon's head.
Bang!
The young man hit the tiger demon directly on the head with a fierce stick.
"Ouch!"
The tiger demon screamed, its limbs twitched a few times and then fell to the ground.
Knocked to death by Qin Guan with a stick...
Seeing this scene, the three young people were stunned.
After looking at the three of them, Qin Guan grabbed the dead tiger demon on the ground and turned away, quickly disappearing into the forest.
After about an hour, Qin Guan finally returned to Tianbao Pavilion, and it was already dark.
When he came to the spiritual material sales area, Qin Guan found the boss who had promised him previously.
When Qin Guan took out a huge tiger demon, the owner of the spiritual material store stared blankly into cow's eggs and said in disbelief: "Boy, are you serious?"
"Aren't you going to change it?" Qin Guan frowned.
"Change, of course!" The boss nodded hurriedly.
